info.title: XamlContrast — static WCAG contrast audit for XAML source
info.description: XamlContrast — static WCAG contrast audit for XAML source. Scans the whole project without launching the app and fails CI when text falls below AA.

options.name: --sarif
options.description: write SARIF 2.1.0 (GitHub code scanning; fail/warn only)

options.name: --md
options.description: write a Markdown report (suitable for a PR comment)

options.name: --html
options.description:
write a self-contained HTML report: colour swatches and ratios
per theme for every failing pair (no scripts, no external files)

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
warn (default): exit 1 on any pair below AA; fail: only on
pairs below the fail line (threshold x fail-factor,
default 0.67). Overrides the config's failOn

options.name: --strict-palette
options.description: fail the run when palette detection degrades

options.name: --min-coverage
options.description:
fail when fewer than N% of colour pairs could be
resolved (default 50; a pass over a fraction of the
project is not a pass). 0 disables.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: ratchet mode: only fail on NEW or WORSENED pairs below the gate

options.name: --write-baseline
options.description:
freeze every pair below AA as known debt (run once, commit the
file); cannot be combined with --baseline

options.name: --show-unresolved
options.description:
list every pair the tool could NOT resolve, with
file:line, reason and the offending value/key

options.name: --stats-preview
options.description:
print the anonymous usage statistics this run would send, and
whether they would be sent, to stderr; sends nothing

options.name: --help
options.description:
print this help
anonymous usage statistics (on by default): after an audit, one request with counts
and ratio ranges only (no names, paths or colours) goes to https://stats.cornhsu.com/
for academic research; --stats-preview shows it. Turn it off with DO_NOT_TRACK=1,
XAMLCONTRAST_SHARE_STATS=false or "stats": { "share": false } in xamlcontrast.config.json.
push options (experimental: may change in a minor release until the dashboard
is publicly deployed). Uploads a report to a Parity dashboard; never audits:

options.name: --branch
options.description:
(experimental) branch to record; else GITHUB_HEAD_REF,
then GITHUB_REF_NAME
The project token is read from XAMLCONTRAST_TOKEN only (no flag: flag values
end up in shell history and CI logs).
exit codes: 0 pass; 1 pairs below the gate; 2 usage, config or input-file error;
3 the result cannot be trusted (0 pairs, degraded palette with
--strict-palette, coverage below --min-coverage)
